critical_code_review_comments: Download endpoint correctly sets Content-Disposition: attachment and Content-Length matching body length; StreamingResponse over BytesIO works for both object-storage and cross-origin source_url photos.
seed_admin correctly updates password_hash when ADMIN_PASSWORD changes (idempotent).
bcrypt hashes stored with $2b$ prefix via bcrypt.hashpw().
Server correctly strips MongoDB _id from all responses via clean() helper and get_current_admin.
JWT_SECRET, MONGO_URL, DB_NAME loaded from env; no hardcoded secrets.

requests.get for source_url in _fetch_photo_bytes is a blocking sync call inside an async endpoint — under load this will block the event loop. Consider httpx.AsyncClient or run_in_threadpool. Not blocking for MVP but worth noting.
download_photo re-fetches full bytes into memory then streams — for very large files consider streaming from object storage directly.

rca of the issue: Original bug: guest downloads opened images in browser because <a download> is ignored cross-origin. Fix (verified working): backend GET /api/photos/{id}/download proxies the image bytes through the API and sets Content-Disposition: attachment; filename="<slug>-NNN.<ext>" with Content-Length. Frontend downloadPhoto() fetches as blob and triggers a same-origin anchor download, so browsers now download instead of navigate.
